# Kilo Plan Files

## Naming Convention

Plans are auto-generated with timestamp + adjective-noun:

```
<unix-timestamp-ms>-<adjective>-<noun>.md
```

Examples: `1775147108635-sunny-wizard.md`, `1775675625928-kind-comet.md`

## Purpose

Plans are execution snapshots — they record what the agent planned to do, what was attempted, and what the outcomes were. They serve as:

- Audit trail for agent actions
- Context for `ROME_PROTOCOL` (return to unfinished work)
- Input for reincarnation extracts

## When Reading Plans

- Sort by timestamp (filename prefix) to get chronological order
- Most recent plan = current or last active execution
- Plans may reference other plans — follow the chain

## When Working With Plans

- Plans are generated by Kilo, not manually authored
- Do not modify existing plans — they are append-only records
- To reference a plan in other files, use the full filename
- Plans inform the state diff in Phase 2 of ROME_PROTOCOL
